<h2>Translated letter:</h2>

O venerable father Bernard, through the power of God admirable works are done in the world. This English translation should not be extracted by the reader.

<h2 class="mt-4">Original letter:</h2>

O venerabilis pater Bernarde, per virtutem Dei admiranda opera fiunt in mundo. Homo enim aliquando magna videt, sed minima prosequitur.

<h2 class="mt-4">Historical context:</h2>

<p>This letter represents Hildegard's early correspondence with Bernard of Clairvaux, seeking his approval for her prophetic visions.</p>

<h2 class="mt-4">Printed source:</h2>

<em>Epistolarium</em>, ed. Van Acker, CCCM 91, p. 3-4.
